title: Coding multiplicity in self-similar sets on the line
summary: We study coding multiplicity for self-similar sets on the real line. When the similarity dimension exceeds one, almost every point with respect to the natural self-similar measure has infinitely many codings. We focus on the case when the similarity dimension is at most one. Our analysis proceeds through the recurrence properties and the size of the critical set, defined as the union of the pairwise intersections of the first-level pieces.
